questions.stem: Which of the following is mentioned as a source of food by early humans?
questions.solution: Cultivated wheat is correct because early humans transitioned from gathering to farming, and wheat was one of the first crops they cultivated. Processed meat, refined sugar, and industrial grains are not consistent with the diets of early humans, who did not have the technology or need for such processed foods.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा भोजन के स्रोत के रूप में प्राचीन मनुष्यों द्वारा उल्लिखित किया गया है?
hi.solution: खेती की गई गेहूं सही है क्योंकि प्राचीन मनुष्यों ने एकत्र करने से खेती में संक्रमण किया और गेहूं उनके द्वारा खेती करने वाले पहले फसलों में से एक था। प्रक्रिया किए गए मांस, शुद्धिकृत चीनी और औद्योगिक अनाज प्राचीन मनुष्यों के आहार के साथ संगत नहीं हैं, जिनके पास ऐसे प्रक्रिया भोजन के लिए तकनीक या आवश्यकता नहीं थी।

questions.stem: Which of the following was the earliest known temple in Mesopotamia?
choices: A small shrine made of unbaked bricks
A large temple with several rooms around open courtyards
A temple with an open courtyard and in-and-out façade
A temple with a defensive wall
questions.solution: The earliest known temple in Mesopotamia was a small shrine made of unbaked bricks, as this structure predates more complex architectural forms. Later temples featured courtyards, multiple rooms, and defensive walls, which were not part of the earliest designs.

questions.stem: If a historian is studying the social practices of early societies, which of the following would be a suitable source?
questions.solution: Ancient written texts are suitable because they provide direct evidence of the beliefs, customs, and daily life of early societies. Modern city records, 21st-century folklore, and contemporary news reports are not related to the time periods and cultures being studied.

hi.stem: यदि एक ऐतिहासिक शुरुआती समाजों के सामाजिक अभ्यासों का अध्ययन कर रहा है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक उपयुक्त स्रोत होगा?
hi.solution: प्राचीन लिखित पाठ उपयुक्त होते हैं क्योंकि वे शुरुआती समाजों के विश्वासों, रीति-रिवाजों और दैनिक जीवन के लिए सीधा प्रमाण प्रदान करते हैं। आधुनिक शहर के रिकॉर्ड, 21वीं शताब्दी की लोककथाएं और आधुनिक समाचार रिपोर्ट्स अध्ययन किए जा रहे समय काल और संस्कृतियों से संबंधित नहीं हैं।
hi.critique: Translation accurately preserves meaning, technical terms are appropriate for Hindi-medium curriculum, and the correct answer remains option (2) in the same position.

mr.stem: जर इतिहासवेत्ता जुन्या समाजांच्या सामाजिक पद्धतींचा अभ्यास करत असेल, तर खालीलपैकी कोणते एक उपयुक्त स्रोत असेल?

questions.stem: If Mesopotamians did not have access to metal resources, which of the following would have been the most likely outcome?
choices: They would have stopped building cities
They would have focused on developing agriculture only
They would have engaged in trade with other regions
They would have stopped using bronze tools
questions.solution: Without access to metal resources, Mesopotamians would have needed to obtain metals from other areas, making trade a necessary and likely response. The other options are incorrect because cities and bronze tools were central to their society, so they would not have abandoned them entirely. Focusing only on agriculture would not have addressed their need for metal-based tools and weapons.

वे कांस्य उपकरणों के उपयोग को बंद कर देते

questions.stem: If a historian is trying to understand the lives of early people, which of the following would they most likely study?
questions.solution: Archaeological remains provide direct evidence of how early people lived, such as through bones and tools. Modern technology, fictional stories, and contemporary art do not offer insights into the lives of early people. These remains help scientists reconstruct past human activities and environments.

questions.stem: If a historian wants to understand the social practices of early societies, which of the following would be the most useful source?
choices: A fictional story set in ancient times
An ancient epic like the Mahabharata
A recent documentary about ancient civilizations
questions.solution: An ancient epic like the Mahabharata provides direct insight into the beliefs, values, and social structures of the time it was created, making it a primary source for understanding early societies. Modern textbooks and documentaries are secondary sources that may interpret or simplify historical information. Fictional stories, while potentially reflective of cultural themes, are not reliable for factual historical understanding.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the relationship between war leaders and the community in early Mesopotamia?
choices: War leaders were chosen solely based on their ability to read and write cuneiform
War leaders were seen as temporary figures who could not maintain long-term influence
War leaders gained influence by distributing loot and organizing temple activities
War leaders were not involved in the community's daily life
questions.solution: War leaders in early Mesopotamia gained influence by distributing loot and organizing temple activities, which helped them build support and establish a more permanent role in society. This is supported by evidence that their power was tied to their ability to provide resources and maintain religious institutions. The other options are incorrect because they either overstate or misrepresent the nature of their influence, such as suggesting they were chosen only for literacy or not involved in daily life.
